1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the method is performed by a processing device configured to execute the steps.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user, wherein the second unique identifier is processed by a user interface associated with the processing device.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized for a user role, wherein the role is defined by a user profile stored in the processing device. 

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for a user, wherein the customization is executed by the processing device based on stored user preferences. 

27. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, and a network interface for communicating with a data store containing the user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier.
